title: Working with storage for Amazon RDS DB instances
note: Lesson 3.3 (K04): confirmed RDS gp3 General Purpose SSD storage provides a baseline of 3,000 IOPS and 125 MiB/s that rises to 12,000 IOPS and 500 MiB/s once striping kicks in above a per-engine size threshold, while io2 Block Express Provisioned IOPS SSD storage is recommended for I/O-intensive, latency-sensitive workloads and scales up to 256,000 IOPS.
